    """Return the ISO representation of a real calendar date, or None."""

    raw = params.get("date")
    if not isinstance(raw, str):

    text = raw.strip()

    match = _ISO_RE.fullmatch(text)
    if match:
        year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
        iso = _valid_date(year, month, day)
        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})

    if match:

        month = _MONTH_ABBR.get(name.lower())
        if month is None:

        iso = _valid_date(int(year), month, int(day))
        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})

    match = _MONTH_RE.fullmatch(text)
    if match:
        name, day, year = match.groups()
        month = _MONTHS.get(name.lower())
        if month is None:
            return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
        iso = _valid_date(int(year), month, int(day))
        return (200, {"date": iso}) if iso else (400, {"error": "invalid date"})

    match = _DAY_FIRST_RE.fullmatch(text)
    if match:
        day, month, year = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
        iso = _valid_date(year, month, day)
